008package release.support;
009
010/**
011 * Encapsulates version information for the Glyco-PAINT software.
012 */
013public final class VersionInfo {
014    public final String releaseVersion;
015    public final String nextDevVersion;
016    public VersionInfo(String release, String next) {
017        this.releaseVersion = release;
018        this.nextDevVersion = next;
019    }
020}
